messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH severity - auth-service token reuse spike detected for tenant stg-xyz (rate 1200/min). Automatic mitigation attempted (fallback to cached tokens) — investigate.
oncall-kris: Acked. Paging SRE + Sec. I’m on my way. :rotating_light:
sre-jordan: I’m oncall, digging in. Can someone confirm whether staging logs were recently exported or if any S3 buckets were changed?
sec-lin: Quick heads-up: we have a hit in our log-forwarder showing uploads to s3://redwood-staging-logs with ACL=PublicRead. Pulling object list now.
eng-sam: Running quick check: `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-staging-logs --query Grants` -> returns ["AllUsers:READ"]. That explains exposure.
sre-jordan: Paste of suspicious auth event (sanitized):
```
2026-03-17T01:23:45Z auth=token_verify svc=auth-service tenant=stg-xyz user=svc-app-23 token_id=abc123 reused=true src_ip=45.33.12.77 req_id=abcd-1234
```
sec-lin: Confirmed token reuse from multiple IPs in that /24. Looks like crawlers hitting exposed logs then replaying tokens. Immediate actions: 1) rotate service account keys that are in those logs, 2) block IP range at edge, 3) lock bucket ACL, 4) invalidate active tokens for affected tenants.
oncall-kris: SRE take 2 and 4. Sec take 1 and coordinate with Eng for 3. Cust-success prepare comms if any customer-visible failures. Legal standby.
sre-jordan: Applying WAF block for 45.33.12.0/24 now: `edge-cli block-ip 45.33.12.0/24 --reason "suspicious token replay"` — done, returning 403. Also kicking session invalidation: `authctl invalidate --tenant stg-xyz --reason "compromised tokens"` (started).
sec-lin: Rotating keys for svc-auth and svc-log-forwarder. KMS rotation in progress; scripts run: `scripts/rotate-keys.sh svc-auth` -> new keys published to staging config, old keys disabled. ETA ~4m. Also updating secrets manager and triggering redeploy of log-forwarder with new creds.
eng-sam: Changing bucket ACL to private: `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-staging-logs --acl private` -> Done. Also adding bucket policy to disallow public put/list.
cust-success-amy: Scanned a sample of exposed objects (non-prod logs). No clear customer PII found in random sampling but continuing full scan. Drafting customer notice template in case any downstream tenants report issues.
legal-maya: Please preserve evidence. Add export of object list and checksums. If any PII, escalate to legal immediately.
sre-jordan: Rotation complete for svc-auth, invalidation finished. Monitoring auth error rate and new token acceptance. So far 0 new successful replays.
sec-lin: Running search for other buckets with public ACLs and for leaked tokens matching regex. `aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[].Name' | xargs -n1 aws s3api get-bucket-acl` in progress. Found one more staging bucket with overly permissive ACL, patched it.
oncall-kris: Good containment. Action items so far: rotated keys (svc-auth, svc-log-forwarder), set bucket private, blocked IP range, invalidated tokens, started scan for PII, notified legal. Any customer impact?
cust-success-amy: Minimal — a couple staging canaries failed due to token invalidation, no production services affected. Communicating with the one internal partner who uses that staging tenant.
legal-maya: Keep the chain of custody notes and save logs to secure archive: `secure-archive save --incident 1768500123`.
sre-jordan: Creating incident channel #incidents-1768500123 for follow-ups and forensic artifacts. Handoff: I’ll monitor for 2h then pass to oncall-midnight. If any anomaly >5m, re-alert.
oncall-kris: Thanks team. Summary for postmortem: root cause = staging bucket ACL misconfiguration which leaked logs containing long-lived service tokens; remediation = rotate keys, lock ACLs, WAF block, token invalidation, scan for PII, update infra CI to prevent public ACLs. Owners: Sec=L in, SRE=Jordan, Eng=Sam, Cust=Amy, Legal=Maya.
sec-lin: Adding preventative task: add IaC guardrail to fail `terraform apply` if s3 bucket has public ACL. Filing ticket in infra-security board.
eng-sam: Noted. Will include in next sprint.
sre-jordan: Handoff to night oncall @sre-lee. Monitoring continues in channel. Closing pager for this thread. :white_check_mark:
